subject: POC outcomes and a quick advocacy ask
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@orchardanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T09:32:00-08:00
Subject: POC outcomes and a quick advocacy ask

Hi Lisa,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the 3-week POC. We ran the final comparison jobs this morning and wanted to share a very short summary and one small favor (two-minute ask). Highlights: 

- Average inference latency (99th pct) improved from ~320ms to ~185ms for your 1k-2k token requests (~42% reduction).
- Cost per 100k tokens dropped by ~60% after moving to our batch+KV-cache settings in production mode.
- Peak throughput supported: from 120 to 320 requests/min with the same reserved pool.
- No production-facing errors across the test window (uptime ~99.7% for the last 7 days).

I've attached the POC_kpi_dashboard.pdf and a compact CSV with per-workload numbers (orchard_summary_table.csv).

Would you be comfortable providing a one-line endorsement we can use in marketing (e.g., 1–2 sentences + logo permission)? Alternately, if you prefer a quick 10-minute call, I can walk a member of our marketing team through a draft and we can capture a short quote on the call. Proposed slots: Wednesday 11/24 10:00–10:15 PT or Thursday 11/25 09:00–09:15 PT.

If you'd rather have us draft an attribution-first version for you to approve, say so and we'll send a 1-line suggestion by EOD. We won't publish anything without explicit approval.

Thanks again — the outcomes here are great and I'd love to showcase Orchard's results (with your permission).

Best,
Rishi
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: POC_kpi_dashboard.pdf (PDF), orchard_summary_table.csv (CSV)]

--
